fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/CategoryListingPayload.cy.js#CategoryPages - PayloadListing [ton2_5to5] [en] — 2.5 ton - 5 ton Trucks TC-PL-04: Call Now assistance lead submits successfully on 2.5 ton - 5 ton Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PL-04
**Title:** Call Now assistance lead submits successfully on 2.5 ton - 5 ton Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the 2.5 ton - 5 ton Trucks page, click the "Still confused?" widget's Call Now button to open the assistance lead form, fill model, name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
The assistance form closes after a successful submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the 2.5 ton - 5 ton Trucks page
2. Click Call Now to open the assistance lead form
3. Fill model, name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify the assistance form closes
